title: Clásico Joven Shakes Up Estadio Azteca This Saturday
seoTitle: Clásico Joven at Estadio Azteca: Preview & Lineups
subtitle: Decisive match between historical rivals returns to the stage of Mexican football
excerpt: Cruz Azul and América meet at Estadio Azteca this Saturday in a match promising emotion and rivalry after inconsistent seasons.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The classic match between Cruz Azul and América returns to Estadio Azteca this Saturday, September 12, following a sequence of games that has put fans on high alert. The match, scheduled for 9:15 PM (local time), has generated great anticipation due to the historical rivalry and the teams' current form.

What Motivates the Rivals' Reunion

América arrives as the leader of the Apertura 2026, with 16 points in six games and one match still in hand. The club seeks to overcome the frustration of finishing fourth in the 2026 Leagues Cup and maintain its winning momentum. Cruz Azul, meanwhile, is trying to reverse an irregular performance—four wins and three losses—and improve a defense that has already conceded 11 goals this season.

Expected Lineups and Important Returns

Guillermo Almada, América's coach, is expected to count on the return of Luis Ángel Malagón in goal after recovering from an Achilles tendon injury. Miguel Borja will be the offensive reference, supported by Brian Rodríguez and Isaías Violante. On Cruz Azul's side, Joel Huiqui indicates the availability of Gonzalo Piovi and Carlos Rotondi, while Erik Lira returns to training following a failed negotiation with Monaco. Rodolfo Rotondi and Juan José Calero also return after long-term injuries, expanding the options on the bench.

Recent History Between the Teams

Since the rivalry began in 1964, América leads the matchup with 33 wins, compared to 22 for Cruz Azul and 27 draws. In the last ten encounters, the score is balanced: three triumphs for each side and four draws. In decisive matches—finals and semifinals—América emerged victorious on all three occasions, claiming the Clausura 2024 title and reaching the final in two other editions.

Expectations for the Game

The classic is usually unpredictable, and the teams' recent form reinforces this uncertainty. While América boasts the best defense of the Apertura 2026, with only two goals conceded, Cruz Azul has shown defensive vulnerability. The duel at the Azteca, a shared venue for both clubs, will be decisive in determining who maintains supremacy in the rivalry and who seizes the opportunity to change the narrative of the season.
